title: Fantasy Player News
description: Breaking Fantasy Football player news along with the impact for fantasy managers

items.author: Ari Koslow
items.title: Zay Flowers (hamstring) practices Wednesday
items.desc: Zay Flowers practiced on Wednesday.
items.impact: Flowers returned from a hamstring injury last week. It appears he didn't suffer any setbacks in his return.

items.author: Ari Koslow
items.title: Ronnie Stanley (toe) returns to practice Wednesday
items.desc: Ronnie Stanley was back at practice on Wednesday.
items.impact: Stanley was sidelined last week for the Ravens. His presence at practice is a positive sign for his return this week.

items.author: Ari Koslow
items.title: Trey Hendrickson (finger) not practicing Wednesday
items.desc: Trey Hendrickson is not practicing on Wednesday.
items.impact: Hendrickson continues to play through a finger injury. His status will need to be monitored in practice the rest of the week.

items.author: Ari Koslow
items.title: Lamar Jackson not practicing Wednesday
items.desc: Lamar Jackson was not present at practice on Wednesday.
items.impact: It is unclear what the reason why is. Jackson's status will need to be monitored when the injury report is released.

items.author: Ari Koslow
items.title: Kenyon Sadiq to be limited in practice Wednesday
items.desc: Kenyon Sadiq will be limited in practice on Wednesday.
items.impact: Sadiq is coming off a career best performance this past week. He should remain in a bigger role if Adonai Mitchell (finger) misses another game.

items.author: Ari Koslow
items.title: Tyjae Spears not practicing Wednesday
items.desc: Tyjae Spears is not practicing on Wednesday.
items.impact: Spears and Tony Pollard will both be sidelined from practice to begin the week. They'll need to be monitored in practice on Thursday ahead of Week 4 against the Ravens.

items.author: Ari Koslow
items.title: Tony Pollard will not practice Wednesday
items.desc: Tony Pollard is not practicing on Wednesday.
items.impact: Pollard and Tyjae Spears will both be sidelined from practice to begin the week. They'll need to be monitored in practice on Thursday ahead of Week 4 against the Ravens.

items.author: Ari Koslow
items.title: Minkah Fitzpatrick (groin) expected to return in Week 4
items.desc: Jets head coach Aaron Glenn said there's a "good chance" Minkah Fitzpatrick plays on Sunday.
items.impact: Fitzpatrick should return to practice this week. His status will need to be monitored on the injury report.

items.author: Ari Koslow
items.title: Dylan Parham not practicing Wednesday
items.desc: Dylan Parham will not practice on Wednesday.
items.impact: Parham is considered week-to-week.

items.author: Ari Koslow
items.title: Adonai Mitchell (finger) not practicing Wednesday
items.desc: Adonai Mitchell will remain sidelined from practice on Wednesday.
items.impact: Jets head coach Aaron Glenn said Mitchell is considered week-to-week. He is likely to sit this Sunday.

items.author: Ari Koslow
items.title: Breece Hall (quad) not practicing Wednesday
items.desc: Breece Hall will be sidelined from practice on Wednesday.
items.impact: Jets head coach Aaron Glenn said Hall is considered week-to-week. He is likely to sit this Sunday.

items.author: Ari Koslow
items.title: Mason Taylor (thumb) not practicing Wednesday
items.desc: Mason Taylor will remain sidelined from practice on Wednesday.
items.impact: Jets head coach Aaron Glenn said Taylor is considered week-to-week. He is likely to sit this Sunday.

items.author: Ari Koslow
items.title: Jaylen Wright (foot) limited in practice Wednesday
items.desc: Jaylen Wright was limited during practice Wednesday.
items.impact: Wright was sidelined last week. When he is healthy, he'll figure to step into a committee with Ollie Gordon with De'Von Achane (knee) out for the season.

items.author: Ari Koslow
items.title: Caleb Douglas (ankle) misses practice Wednesday
items.desc: Caleb Douglas did not practice on Wednesday.
items.impact: Douglas did not play last week and he seems likely to miss another game. Malik Washington and Chris Bell would continue to see more run.

items.author: Ari Koslow
items.title: Jaycee Horn (quad) placed on IR
items.desc: The Panthers placed CB Jaycee Horn on injured reserve.
items.impact: Horn suffered a quad tear in Week 3's loss to Cleveland. He could miss most of the season.

items.author: Ari Koslow
items.title: Mike Jackson Sr. (groin) placed on IR
items.desc: The Panthers placed CB Mike Jackson Sr. on injured reserve.
items.impact: Jackson will miss at least the next four weeks with a groin injury.

items.author: Ari Koslow
items.title: Rachaad White receiving treatment for shoulder injury
items.desc: Commanders head coach Dan Quinn said Rachaad White is receiving treatment for his shoulder injury.
items.impact: It is unclear if it will impact the status of White heading into Week 4. Jacory Croskey-Merritt could see more work with Austin Ekeler still uncertain to make his Commanders debut.

items.author: Ari Koslow
items.title: Jayden Daniels (elbow) to be limited in practice Wednesday
items.desc: Commanders head coach Dan Quinn said Jayden Daniels will be limited in Wednesday's practice.
items.impact: Daniels will practice in some fashion this week. He remains unlikely to return this Sunday.

items.author: Ari Koslow
items.title: Josh Simmons (back) not practicing Wednesday
items.desc: Josh Simmons is expected to remain sidelined from practice on Wednesday.
items.impact: Simmons is continuing to work his way back from a back injury. He is expected to be the lone player not to practice for Kansas City.

items.author: Ari Koslow

items.author: Diego Sandoval
items.title: Jayden Reed (neck) to undergo season-ending surgery
items.desc: Jayden Reed will undergo season-ending neck surgery after suffering the injury in Week 2.
items.impact: This seemed like the direction Reed was trending after he was stretchered off the field against the Jets. The wideout will now take the full season and off-season to get surgery and rehab. The Packers will lean heavily on Matthew Golden and Christian Watson in the passing game, while Skyy Moore has been the main beneficiary of Reed's absence.

items.author: Ari Koslow
items.title: Rakeem Nunez-Roches Sr. (ankle) misses practice Wednesday
items.desc: Rakeem Nunez-Roches Sr. did not practice on Wednesday.
items.impact: Nunez-Roches is dealing with an ankle injury. His status will need to be monitored the rest of the week.

items.author: Ari Koslow
items.title: Ko Kieft (elbow) working on side at practice Wednesday
items.desc: Ko Kieft was seen working on the side at practice on Wednesday.
items.impact: Kieft was working with a brace on his left elbow. His status will need to be monitored the rest of the week.

items.author: Ari Koslow
items.title: Yaya Diaby works on side at practice Wednesday
items.desc: Yaya Diaby was seen working on the side with trainers at practice on Wednesday.
items.impact: Diaby's status will need to be monitored when the official injury report is released.

items.author: Ari Koslow
items.title: Rueben Bain Jr. (groin) works on side at practice Wednesday
items.desc: Rueben Bain Jr. was working with trainers on the side in practice on Wednesday.
items.impact: Bain is working his way back from a groin injury. His status will need to be monitored when the official injury report is released.

items.impact: Bell will figure to seek another opportunity.

items.author: Ari Koslow
items.title: Frankie Luvu (groin) to travel with Commanders to London
items.desc: Commanders LB Frankie Luvu will travel with the team to London.
items.impact: Luvu has been sidelined with a groin injury. He'll have a chance to return against the Colts this week.

items.author: Ari Koslow
items.title: Chig Okonkwo (hamstring) to travel with Commanders to London
items.desc: Commanders TE Chig Okonkwo will travel with the team to London.
items.impact: Okonkwo will have a chance to return this week against the Colts. He has been sidelined ever since suffering a hamstring injury during Week 1.

items.author: Ari Koslow
items.title: Jovaughn Gwyn suffers fractured fibula, could miss 2-to-3 months
items.desc: Ravens OL Jovaughn Gwyn suffered a fractured fibula that will likely require surgery.
items.impact: The injury could force Gwyn to miss two to three months. He had won the team's starting center job in training camp.

items.author: Ari Koslow
items.title: Kevin Zeitler signs with Packers
items.desc: The Packers signed veteran OL Kevin Zeitler to a one-year contract.
items.impact: Zeitler will provide an immediate boost to a banged up Green Bay offensive line. He has played 14 seasons and will add veteran experience to the position group.

items.author: Ari Koslow
items.title: Jason Sanders signs with Jets' active roster
items.desc: The Jets signed K Jason Sanders to their active roster.
items.impact: Sanders officially wins the starting kicking job for the Jets.

items.author: Ari Koslow
items.title: Cody White signs with Raiders' active roster
items.desc: The Raiders signed WR Cody White to their active roster.
items.impact: White has scored three touchdowns in the past two weeks. He gets the opportunity with Jack Bech (forearm) placed on IR.

items.author: Ari Koslow
items.title: Jack Bech (forearm) placed on IR
items.desc: The Raiders placed WR Jack Bech on injured reserve.
items.impact: Bech will miss at least the next four weeks. Cody White was promoted as the corresponding move.

items.desc: The Vikings signed RB Devin Neal.
items.impact: Neal will add depth in the Vikings backfield.

items.author: Ari Koslow

items.impact: Rypien will add depth in the Bucs quarterback room.

items.author: Ari Koslow
items.title: Rico Dowdle (toe) misses practice Tuesday
items.desc: Rico Dowdle did not practice on Tuesday.
items.impact: Dowdle is likely to remain sidelined on Thursday against the Browns. Jaylen Warren should remain in the lead role.

items.author: Ari Koslow
items.title: Nick Cross (illness) ruled out Week 4
items.desc: Nick Cross has been ruled out for Week 4 against the Colts.
items.impact: Cross did not travel with the team to London. He remains week-to-week.

items.author: Ari Koslow
items.title: Sam Cosmi (concussion/throat) ruled out Week 4
items.desc: Sam Cosmi has been ruled out for Week 4 against the Colts.
items.impact: Cosmi will not make the trip to London. He remains week-to-week.

items.author: Ari Koslow
items.title: Jalen Ramsey dealing with broken wrist
items.desc: Steelers CB Jalen Ramsey has a broken wrist.
items.impact: Ramsey remains hopeful to play on Thursday against the Browns. He was limited in practice to start the week.

items.author: Ari Koslow
items.title: Joey Porter Jr. (conditioning) logs full practice Tuesday
items.desc: Joey Porter Jr. was a full participant in Tuesday's practice.
items.impact: Porter has not played the first three weeks of the season as he works out a contract dispute. It appears he is on track to play on Thursday against the Browns.
